commits.subject: Allow Bedrock Runtime selection during setup and login (#62222)
commits.reason: Accept the optional, typed Amazon Bedrock Runtime selection on app-server setup and login. Keep the Mantle default, existing onboarding behavior, and existing credential and provider policy checks.
evidence: Reviewed the exact 20 changed paths and binary schema exports against bcff988bd1. Binary diff SHA-256 0e7d50ce488b79e6709a0cab94fce67983d730a0efc1c3a904e3986e4b995c87.

Profile and environment setup, API-key login, and access-key login share the typed provider selection. The resolver maps only the two built-in provider IDs, checks the selected provider for credential export, and retains region and allowed-login validation.
Legacy requests omit providerId and still select Mantle. The TUI still sends None on the existing onboarding paths. Generated JSON, TypeScript, and Python mirror the additive optional request field.

Source-declared controls only. login_amazon_bedrock_replaces_primary_auth_and_persists_provider covers legacy and Runtime for both credential forms and logout cleanup. setup_bedrock_profile_and_environment and setup_bedrock_rejects_invalid_or_conflicting_credentials cover persisted routing and exporter conflicts.
commits.revisit: Run the paired legacy and Runtime login and setup controls with isolated credentials and verify the Runtime thread provider. Preserve account isolation and provider-lock precedence on integration.
